display_chapter_path: 洗钱和恐怖融资的风险及方法
content.stem: 为协助调查一起跨境洗钱案件，作为埃格蒙特集团成员的金融情报机构(FIU)可以:

options.A: 直接与另一国的金融机构联系并分享与调查相关的信息
options.B: 直接与其他国家的金融情报机构(FIU)联系并分享与调查相关的信息
options.C: 授权其执法调查人员协助另一国正在进行的重大调查
options.D: 协助另一国执法部门进行重大在办案件的调查

content.stem_en: To provide aid in investigating a cross-border money laundering case, a Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) that is a member of the Egmont Group can:

options_en.A: Directly contact financial institutions in another country and share information pertinent to the investigation
options_en.B: Directly contact other FIUs in another country and share information pertinent to the investigation
options_en.C: Deputize its law enforcement investigators to assist in a material ongoing investigation in another country
options_en.D: Assist law enforcement in another country with a material ongoing investigation
